flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository (findNoticesForMhaNricUpload, findToppanNoticesForStage), framework/workflows/agencies/mha/{upload/helpers/MhaNricDataHelper, upload/jobs/MhaNricUploadJob, download/helpers/MhaNricDownloadHelper, download/jobs/MhaNricDownloadJob}, framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService, framework/schedulers/MhaDownloadJobsScheduler, resources/cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not used for this story. The stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ at the repo root is not used as evidence.
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark: Vault Code Split (Vault must run because the notice needs vehicle and owner info, Vault connection permission is granted to the App Service). There is no flow deck, so Sesuai means the code follows the story text. The particulars check and update (Epic OCMS8) lives in the MHA upload/download jobs (NRIC, id_type N) and the DataHive UEN/FIN job (id_type F and B); the notice selection queries include stage RD2, so notices heading to the 2nd letter are checked. Updates only touch the current offender row (OCMS-DF-2026-177, Closed, deployed). Gaps: (1) the DataHive UEN/FIN job is off in prod (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false); (2) no gate in the code makes the 2nd letter wait for the MHA result, the order only comes from the cron schedule (MHA upload 09:00/14:00/21:00, download 11:30/16:30/23:30, Toppan 00:15), so a late MHA result does not hold the letter; (3) the story precondition about an electronic reminder sent or opt-out is not a condition in the MHA/Toppan queries; (4) the file exchange with MHA, the result file content, Vault and the SFTP permission cannot be verified from repo. Tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-177 (offender indicator), OCMS-DF-2026-133 (remark: the MHA cron was not yet turned on in PRD at that time, differing from cron.mhaupload.enabled=true in the properties; the real value cannot be verified), OCMS-DF-2026-176 (owner_driver timestamps, still Ready to UAT).
recommendation: Claim partially. The MHA selector and the offender particulars update exist and are enabled in the prod properties; the DataHive FIN/UEN path is off in prod and no gate holds the 2nd letter until the MHA result arrives. Ask for proof that the MHA cron is active in PRD and for a URA decision on the gate.

steps.step: OCMS selects owner notices heading to the 2nd letter (stage RD2) for a particulars check with MHA (NRIC holders)
steps.detail: findNoticesForMhaNricUpload selects notices with next_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), next_processing_date <= tomorrow, suspension_type IS NULL, id_type = 'N', offender_indicator = 'Y', not yet in ocms_nro_temp and the ID not in ocms_hst (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:556-581). The helper calls this query (MhaNricDataHelper.java:77-81) and MhaNricUploadJob builds the enquiry file from the result (MhaNricUploadJob.java:156). So due notices at stage RD2 are sent to MHA. The story precondition that the electronic reminder was sent or the owner opted out is not checked in this query. Job schedule: cron.mhaupload.schedule=0 0 9,14,21 ? * MON-SAT, enabled=true (cron-schedules-prod.properties:105-106).

steps.step: Latest NRIC owner particulars from MHA are received and updated (name, date of birth/death, life status, address) on the current offender record
steps.detail: MhaNricDownloadJob reads the result file (processResponseFile, MhaNricDownloadJob.java:556) then applyStatusUpdates (MhaNricDownloadJob.java:633; MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:484-486). name, lifeStatus, dateOfBirth, dateOfDeath and the mha_reg address are updated only on rows with offender_indicator = 'Y' (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:777-779 and 834-860); if the ID is no longer the offender the record is skipped and written as an error row in the report. The download job is enabled in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:119-120). Sebagian because: the NRO file exchange with MHA over SFTP and the result file content cannot be verified from repo; the remark of ticket OCMS-DF-2026-133 says the MHA cron was not yet turned on in PRD at that time while the properties say enabled=true, the real value cannot be verified; OCMS-DF-2026-176 (owner_driver timestamps not updated) is still Ready to UAT. OCMS-DF-2026-177 (offender indicator check) is Closed and deployed.

steps.step: Particulars of FIN holders and company (UEN) owners are checked and updated through DataHive
steps.detail: DataHiveUenFinService selects notices with next_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type IS NULL, id_type IN ('F','B'), offender_indicator = 'Y' (DataHiveUenFinService.java:225-250), so RD2 notices of FIN/UEN owners are included. But MhaDownloadJobsScheduler skips the second job when cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false (MhaDownloadJobsScheduler.java:43 and 104-107) and the value is false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52, comment: wait until the DataHive view names are verified). So in the prod configuration FIN/UEN owners are not checked. The content of the DataHive (DOS) views cannot be verified from repo.

steps.step: Notices that finished the check can still get the 2nd letter, and notices suspended by the check result are not processed
steps.detail: The Toppan query for stage RD2 only takes notices with suspension_type IS NULL (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:604-613), so notices that the MHA result put under TS-NRO or PS (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:872-880 and 1118-1130) are not printed. But no gate in the code makes the 2nd letter wait for the MHA result: the Toppan query does not look at ocms_nro_temp and the order relies only on the cron schedule (MHA upload 09:00/14:00/21:00, download 11:30/16:30/23:30, Toppan 00:15; cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62, 105, 119). If the MHA result file is a day late, the RD2 notice is still processed by Toppan with the old address. Sebagian.
